thesis: IHH has quality and cash-flow support, but the local snapshot does not justify a directional buy while price remains below all major averages and volume confirmation is absent.
strongest_counterexample: Defensive healthcare demand and continued earnings growth could make the 28.5x forward P/E reasonable and restore the long-term trend.
invalidation_conditions: Earnings or free cash flow weaken while valuation remains elevated.
The price breaks below the 52-week low.
A sustained recovery above SMA-200 fails to develop.
evidence_gaps: Forward earnings assumptions and segment-level growth.
International exposure, regulation, and currency sensitivity.
Usable current news, macro inputs, and volume confirmation.
decisive_factors: Price below all major moving averages with volume at 3% of its 20-day average.
source_note: Fresh Layer 1 data plus current-session English research-only analysis. Portfolio and Layer 5 are excluded.
